mapper.sql: id, parent_id, permission_name, permission_code, permission_type, path, component, icon, sort_order, ext_info, deleted, last_modifier, create_time, update_time
mapper.select:
select
from ( select distinct sp.* from sys_user as su, sys_user_role as sur, sys_role as sr, sys_role_permission as srp, sys_permission as sp where su.login_account = #{loginAccount} and su.id = sur.user_id and sur.role_id = sr.id and sr.id = srp.role_id and srp.permission_id = sp.id and sp.permission_type < 3 ) as sp order by sp.parent_id, sp.sort_order
